items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: I was thinking if you weren’t a friend of Carleton’s I’d say go fuck yourself.

ctx.x: Yeah. Sweet. He was in a Hospice. And he goes, “Chuck, is that Al Tinney?” I go, “Yeah.” He says, “I’m working on my second book on bebop. You think I can get an interview with him.” I was thinking if you weren’t a friend of Carleton’s I’d say go fuck yourself. But I didn’t say it. I treated those guys great. I had great sandwiches in my house. My mother — and he was a funny guy, I’ve got to admit. But yeah, so Gitler did this nice interview with Al, and did a 2-1/2 page part of his second bop book about that. So…
